description: This file defines the class AM_ProjectTemplatesViewDetail, which extends ViewDetail. It primarily creates a web UI for displaying and manipulating project templates, including embedding CSS and JavaScript for dialogs, form handling, and UI interactivity within the SuiteCRM module for project templates.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail responsible for rendering the detailed view of project templates with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and HTML form elements for user interaction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to include custom styles, scripts, and HTML for the project template detail view, including a dialog for project creation.
